infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: We use this so you can quickly call someone you trust during a crisis moment. Your contacts stay on your device — we don't upload them.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: We read your heart rate from Apple Health so the app can soften the soundscape when your body needs it. Nothing about your heart rate leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Hearo reads heart rate data from Apple Health but does not write or update any health data.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: The microphone is only used if you choose to record a video for a Companion step. Nothing you record leaves your device.

plugins.photosPermission: Hearo lets you attach a photo or video to a Companion step, so you can look back on the progress you've made. Your photos stay on your device — we never upload them.
